title: The Illusion of Fairness: Auditing Fairness Interventions with Audit Studies
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspects of faith or religion. The study focuses on age discrimination in hiring decisions.
findings: There are no findings related to religion in this paper. The word 'religion' is mentioned once as an example of a legally protected characteristic, but it is not part of the study's data, methodology, or results.
